sentences.en: The magnets, of course, have a magnetic field around them.
sentences.zh: 当然，磁铁周围会产生磁场。

sentences.en: Induction cookers use magnets to directly heat pots and pans.
sentences.zh: 电磁炉利用磁铁直接加热锅和 pan。

sentences.en: Keeton put magnets on the heads of his pigeons.
sentences.zh: Keeton在他的鸽子头上贴了磁铁。

senses.zh: 磁体，磁铁；有吸引力的人（或地方、事物）
